title: Plan dynamic HDR metadata extraction commands
summary: Adds a pure Dynamic HDR metadata extraction command planner for HEVC stream extraction, Dolby Vision RPU extraction/summary, and HDR10+ JSON extraction. The planner is fail-closed and does not execute tools, change routing, or mutate media.
reason: Dynamic HDR encode preservation needs auditable extraction topology before runtime execution can be safely wired into the high-risk encode path.
behavior_before: Dynamic HDR detection, tool evidence, preserve/remux/review planning, and guarded x265 parameter slots existed, but there was no backend-owned command topology for extracting HEVC, Dolby Vision RPU, or HDR10+ metadata artifacts.
behavior_after: New-DynamicHdrMetadataExtractionPlan returns a dynamic_hdr_metadata_extraction_plan.v1 object with temp artifact paths and command specs. It requires explicit MKV video track IDs, uses ffmpeg Annex-B extraction for non-MKV inputs, supports DoVi profile 7 to 8.1 and profile 8.1, supports HDR10+ JSON extraction, and fails closed for missing paths, tools, track identity, or unsupported profiles.
tests_added: Extended ops/pipeline/tests/Unit/Invoke-DynamicHdrToolingChecks.ps1 with no-op, MKV, MP4, missing-track, missing-tool, and unsupported-profile extraction planner cases.
rollback_plan: Revert this packet plus the Dynamic HDR planner/test/doc/generated-summary changes. Existing detection, preserve/remux/review planning, and x265 parameter wiring remain separate changes.
notes:

High-risk boundary note: this slice plans commands only. It does not execute dovi_tool, hdr10plus_tool, mkvextract, or ffmpeg; it does not change Do-Encode routing; it does not move, delete, publish, or mutate source/output/pending media. Runtime extraction/injection, output verification, policy routing, and representative real-media validation remain open.
